scenarios.scenario_abstract: While driving with a partner and two children to the grandparents' farm in winter, [X] moves among a warm car, icy roadside stops, unloading, and outdoor chores with both hands occupied by children, food, luggage, or safety gear. When rain or snow starts, [X] cannot put everything down to find and hold a separate hat or umbrella.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 冬季与伴侣自驾带两个孩子前往祖父母农场时，[X]会在温暖车内、结冰的途中停靠、卸行李和户外劳作之间切换，双手常被孩子、食物、行李或安全用品占满；雨雪来临时，[X]无法先放下所有东西，再去寻找并拿住单独的帽子或雨伞。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] chooses a safety-certified bicycle helmet only after checking long-ride pressure, ventilation, head circumference, strap position, and physical fit, then keeps the back of the head and neck clear of folded fabric and cords that could shift the helmet or trap heat.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]会在核对长途佩戴压力、通风、头围、带扣位置和实体贴合后才选择符合安全标准的自行车头盔，随后让后脑和颈部远离可能改变头盔位置或积热的折叠布料与绳带。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: To control daily frizz in 3C curls, [X] minimizes touching, seals in moisture, and reserves deliberate satin protection for nighttime, keeping the hair and neckline free of ordinary loose fabric that would rub, flatten, or catch the curls during the day.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了控制 3C 卷发的日常毛躁，[X]减少触碰、锁住水分，并把有意识的缎面防护留到夜间，白天则让头发和领口周围没有会反复摩擦、压扁或勾住卷发的普通松散布料。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] keeps the Tugela Gorge hike only for safe light-rain or post-rain conditions and uses both hands for uneven ground, stream crossings, and route checks. When a passing shower arrives, [X] cannot spare a hand for an umbrella or stop to search the pack for separate head protection; heavy rain still triggers the indoor Plan B.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]只在小雨或雨后仍安全时前往图盖拉峡谷徒步，并把双手用于不平地面、过溪和路线检查；短时阵雨到来时，[X]无法腾出一只手撑伞，也不能停下来翻包寻找单独的头部防护，大雨时仍按计划改去室内地点。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a first family camping trip, [X] sets a tent and rain tarp, manages a stove and food, supervises children, and packs out waste while both hands cycle among lines, cookware, tools, and a child. When passing rain arrives, there is no free hand to hold an umbrella and no practical pause for finding or securing a separate hat.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 初次带家人露营时，[X]需要搭帐篷和防雨布、管理炉具与食物、照看孩子并带走垃圾，双手不断在绳索、炊具、工具和孩子之间切换；短时风雨到来时，没有空手撑伞，也不便停下寻找或固定一顶单独的帽子。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While painting a home in the order of ceilings, trim, and walls, [X] controls a roller, tray, brush, or ladder with both hands and needs to protect the hair and neck before overhead rolling without stopping to locate and secure a separate cap.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 按天花板、装饰线和墙面的顺序刷房时，[X]的双手要控制滚筒、托盘、刷子或梯子，并需要在仰头滚涂前保护头发和颈部，而不必停下来寻找并固定一顶单独的帽子。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After local law, building permission, neighbor safety, and an outdoor flight path make one apartment-based hive feasible, [X] uses both hands on the smoker, hive tool, frames, and feeder during inspections and cannot risk a gap or separation between head-and-neck protection and the rest of the body covering.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在当地法规、楼宇许可、邻里安全和户外飞行路线都允许公寓养一箱蜂后，[X]检查蜂箱时双手要操作烟熏器、蜂箱工具、巢框和饲喂器，头颈防护与其余身体防护之间不能出现缝隙或分离。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: At the start of outdoor training, [X] establishes two 20-to-30-minute runs and one nearby-trail session each week and keeps the head and neckline clear so heat release, hearing, and peripheral vision remain stable without loose material bouncing or needing adjustment.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 刚开始户外训练时，[X]每周安排两次 20 至 30 分钟慢跑和一次附近步道活动，并让头部与领口保持清爽，使散热、听觉和周边视野稳定，不受松散布料弹动或反复调整干扰。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With the necessary competence, [X] services a correctly supported 2020 CLA250 beneath the splash cover using a drain pan and torque tools and keeps the head and neck entirely free of loose fabric or cords that could obscure vision, catch fasteners, or touch warm oil.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 具备相应能力时，[X]会在车辆得到正确支撑后，于 2020 款 CLA250 的底护板下操作接油盘和扭矩工具，并让头颈周围完全没有会遮挡视线、勾住紧固件或接触热油的松散布料与绳带。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Traveling from South Africa to a Seattle soccer match, [X] uses one compact separate cap for waterfront and ferry wind, then removes and stores it before entering the exceptionally loud packed stadium so the head and neckline stay unobstructed for hearing, sightlines, and crowd awareness.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 从南非前往西雅图观看足球比赛时，[X]在滨水区和渡轮的风中使用一顶独立的轻便帽，进入异常嘈杂且拥挤的球场前将其取下收好，让头部和领口保持无阻碍，以维持听觉、视线和人群感知。
